note: The Central African Republic is a member of the Central African Economic and Monetary Community, whose regulation on credit information bureaus (as the BEAC publishes it, its scan's text read as extracted) lets a bureau disseminate only information no more than five years old. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: CEMAC/UMAC Comité Ministériel, Règlement relatif aux conditions d’exercice, de contrôle et de supervision de l’activité des bureaux d’information sur le crédit dans la CEMAC (BEAC)
sources.said: Le BIC ne peut diffuser que les informations dont I'ancienneté n'excède pas cinq (5) ans.
